_comment: Worker-only MCP config (party-to-pipeline sub-windows). Excludes chrome-devtools (real user Chrome port 9222 needs Alan's manual auth). Use with --strict-mcp-config to bypass project .mcp.json autoload. Claude-in-Chrome sandbox MCP loaded via --chrome flag separately. GitNexus added 2026-05-18. 2026-05-22 A2 動作加入 github + context7 + azure (對齊 Ultimate Strategy Report 階段一,子視窗 create/dev/review 也需這 3 個 MCP)。.mcp.json 已在 .gitignore L80,workers-mcp.json 也應同樣保護(若未在 .gitignore 需補)。

codegraph._comment: 2026-05-25 子視窗開放 codegraph(使用者核准,比照 gitnexus 2026-05-18)。context 組裝器。--no-watch:子視窗只查詢不啟動 file watcher,避免與主視窗 watcher 同寫 .codegraph/codegraph.db 競爭(codegraph serve 預設含 watcher,與 gitnexus mcp 純查詢不同)。索引新鮮度由主視窗 watcher 或手動 codegraph index 維持。

github._comment: 2026-05-23 Stage α post-α 調整: Docker ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server + GITHUB_TOOLSETS=B selective(~45-50 tools)。涵蓋 PhyCool use cases。子視窗同步主視窗配置。
